purpose: Long-form explanatory copy in the shared typography article.

evidence.quote: All prose links: weight 500, rgba(44,40,38,.55) underline, hover opacity .8 over 200ms (measured).

quirks: Single body by design, not a whole-page wrapper: the page header (H1 + lead) is already its own hero.page-header node, and the article has no distinct header or footer parts of its own (measured, see extraction/measured-values.json sectionHeights). Where other nodes share the same article element (enterprise: logo grid and HubSpot form; join-us: apply card, team photo, team cards) they are modelled as their own nodes and are excluded from this node's height.

Measured at 1440px: 28px on /enterprise (only the 'Trusted by builders at' label), 887px on /join-us (the intro and the two headed prose runs, 26% of the page) and 1249px on /slack (63% of its 1975px page: prose by nature, whitelisted with justification in wrapperGate.whitelist).
